function.arguments: {"observation": "The reviewer points out that the population in the contract is 'all patients in the trial, after deduplicating on patient_id and keeping the highest sample_seq row for each patient.' I dropped rows with `biomarker_baseline == -999` before deduplication, which means I excluded some patients from the population. This violates the contract, which specifies that the population should include all patients after deduplication, regardless of biomarker values.", "implication": "I must recompute the response rate using the full set of patients after deduplication, including those with `biomarker_baseline == -999`. The presence of sentinel values in `biomarker_baseline` does not justify excluding patients from the population, as the estimand is about response rate, not biomarker levels. I must include all patients in the final population, even if some have failed QC in the baseline assay. The biomarker data is not used in the response rate computation, so excluding patients based on it is unjustified. I will now recompute the response rate on the full deduplicated dataset, including all patients, and report the difference in proportions."}
function.name: note_finding
